start.title: Set up tickets by answering questions
start.description: Answer a few questions and we'll set up your Full Pass, Day Pass, single classes, parties and early-bird prices — no need to figure out blocks and exclusion rules yourself.
start.replaceWarning: This replaces your current ticket setup. Tickets people already bought are taken off sale, and their registrations are kept.
start.outOfSync: These tickets were changed in advanced mode, so the advanced settings below are what's live. To manage them with the ticket wizard again, run it again (it replaces the current setup).

header.title: Ticket wizard
header.rail: Set up tickets, one question at a time
header.discardConfirm: Your unapplied changes will be lost. Leave anyway?

help.title: Every event sells a little differently
help.body: If this step doesn't match how you want to sell, message me and we'll work out how to set it up. For anything the wizard doesn't cover yet, you can use advanced mode for now.

nav.finishCreate: Create {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}
nav.finishEdit: Apply {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}

type.title: What kind of event are you selling?
type.description: Pick the closest one — the next questions adapt to it. You can change it later.
type.workshopDescription: Classes, usually with a party at night
type.daysDescription: Filled in from the event dates. Used for Day Passes and class days.

tiers.title: Do prices go up over time?
tiers.description: Dance events usually go super early bird → early bird → door. Prices switch automatically when each tier ends.
tiers.lastNote: The last tier doesn't end — it's also the door price
tiers.single: Every ticket keeps one price for the whole registration period. Come back to this step any time to add early-bird prices.

full.title: Are you selling a Full Pass?
full.description: One ticket for every class. Most people buy this one, so it's listed first.
full.includesParty: Does the Full Pass include the parties?
full.pricesHint: Attendees only see the current tier's price.
full.skipped: That's fine — set up Day Passes or single classes next.

day.title: Are you selling Day Passes?
day.description: For people who can only come one day. The event has {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, so there's one Day Pass per day.
day.samePrice: Same price every day (changing one changes all)
day.skipped: No Day Passes. People who can only come one day can buy that day's classes.

classes.title: Can people buy single classes?
classes.description: Add each class you want to sell on its own, e.g. "Day 1 · Body Movement 14:00–15:00".
classes.tiered: Single classes follow the price tiers too
classes.empty: No classes yet. Tap "Add a class" to start.
classes.skipped: Classes are only included in passes.

party.title: Are you selling party tickets on their own?
party.description: For people who only want to dance, not take classes.
party.yes: Yes, parties can be bought alone
party.namePlaceholder: Party name, e.g. Saturday Night Party
party.tiered: Party tickets follow the price tiers too
party.empty: No parties yet. Tap "Add a party" to start.
party.skipped: Parties aren't sold on their own.

entry.title: How much is entry?
entry.description: A party usually has one entry ticket that follows the price tiers.
entry.add: Add another ticket (e.g. entry with a lesson)

rules.fullLocksDay: People who pick the Full Pass can't also pick a Day Pass.
rules.fullLocksClasses: People who pick the Full Pass don't see single classes (they're all included).
rules.dayPlusClasses: People with a Day Pass can add classes from another day.
rules.fullLocksParty: The Full Pass includes the parties, so its buyers don't see party tickets.
rules.partyAddOn: Party tickets can be added to any ticket.

special.title: Any special offers?
special.description: Pick any that apply, or just go to the next step.
special.pairDescription: A discount when two people register together, e.g. a leader and a follower.
special.pairHint: Calculated for you — you can still edit it. Registration asks for both attendees.
special.pairNeedsFull: Sell a Full Pass first to add a couple ticket.
special.earlyDescription: Only sold in one tier, like a "buy one get one" ticket. It shows as closed afterwards.
special.earlyHint: Once that tier ends, the registration page shows it as closed instead of hiding it, so people know they missed it.
special.earlyNeedsTiers: Turn on price tiers first to use this.
special.earlyNeedsFull: Sell a Full Pass first to add an early-bird special.
special.couponDescription: For students, regulars or partner studios — they enter a code to get a discount.
special.rateAria: Fraction of the price, out of 10
special.more: Need another kind of offer, like a group of 3 or a student ID check at the door?

review.title: Review your tickets
review.description: Confirming creates every ticket at once. You can come back to any step later from Tickets.
review.mixDayDesc: Pick a Day Pass, then add classes or parties if they like
review.mixFreeDesc: Pick the classes and parties they want
review.blankNames: Some tickets don't have a name yet
review.tierDates: Each price tier has to end after the one before it
review.couponCode: Discount codes can only use letters, numbers, - and _

blocks.singleDesc: Pick the classes or parties you want

summary.title: Your tickets so far
summary.count: {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} so far
summary.remaining: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} to go
summary.singlePrice: One price for the whole registration period

overview.banner: These tickets were set up with the ticket wizard
overview.bannerHint: "Edit" next to each section takes you back to that step, and the tickets update when you're done.
overview.advancedBar: You're in advanced mode. Changes here take over from the ticket plan.
overview.title: Ticket plan
overview.createHint: Tickets go on sale like this once the event is created.
overview.hiddenItems: {count, plural, one {# more ticket is} other {# more tickets are}} off sale but kept for existing registrations — see advanced mode.
overview.builtHint: This is what you'd see in advanced mode. You usually don't need to touch it.
overview.helpBody: Tell me how you'd like to sell —

rail.tiers: {count, plural, one {# tier} other {# tiers}}, switching automatically
